name: cccomplete
description: Completes the word at the end of your prompt from a trie of your conversation, with an inline suggestion and a bar of alternatives

accept_key.title: Accept key
accept_key.description: Key that accepts the shown suggestion. Examples: tab, ctrl+y, meta+enter.

next_key.title: Next-suggestion key
next_key.description: Key that moves to the next suggestion. A letter needs ctrl or meta.

previous_key.title: Previous-suggestion key
previous_key.description: Key that moves to the previous suggestion. A letter needs ctrl or meta.

display.title: Display
display.description: Where suggestions appear: inline in the prompt, in a bar above it, or both.

limit.title: Suggestions shown
limit.description: How many suggestions the bar offers, from 1 to 9.

min_prefix.title: Minimum letters
min_prefix.description: How many letters you type before suggestions appear, from 1 to 4.

trailing_space.title: Add a space after accepting
trailing_space.description: Add a space after an accepted word.

sources.title: Words come from
sources.description: Which text feeds the trie: your prompts, Claude's answers, or both.
